name: reborrow
declaration: unsafe fn reborrow (& mut self) -> & 'a mut T
documentation:
Borrows a new mutable reference from the unique borrow initially captured.

 # Safety

 The reborrow must have ended, i.e., the reference returned by `new` and
 all pointers and references derived from it, must not be used anymore.
rules: Before calling `DormantMutRef::reborrow`, the prior reborrow must have ended: the reference returned by `DormantMutRef::new` and all pointers and references derived from it must not be used anymore.
